decision: Build approach D: a first-class Tiller.Mutation vocabulary across 5 axes (whitelist, result override, driver swap, injected latency, process kill), N-way concurrent fork race under DynamicSupervisor, LiveView inspector, and automatic first-divergence plus smallest-decisive-mutation analysis.
rationale: Chosen over C (single whitelist axis, recommended), A (vertical slice), B (event core first). Effort XL, risk High, accepted knowingly. Only version that makes the screen an instrument rather than a spectacle. Foundation is 250-400 lines (revised up from a 30-line estimate after Codex verified spawn_subagent blocks at actions.ex:52): cast-based session loop, attributed ordered event store replacing the global list, Phoenix.PubSub, Replay driver with recorded-result injection. Documented fallback to approach C if the 30-minute divergence-detection spike fails.
